response.justification: Bogdan Szabo has extensive software development experience and strong technical skills, but his background is heavily skewed toward web, mobile, and embedded systems development rather than hardware optimization, SoC modeling, or AI accelerator architecture. His lack of demonstrated work in deep-learning workload optimization, GPU architecture, or hardware-software co-design makes him a weak fit for this Principal-level role. While he has leadership and system design experience, it does not align closely enough with the specialized requirements of cloud infrastructure and AI accelerator hardware optimization.
strengths: Strong software engineering background with diverse full-stack experience across multiple languages and frameworks
Proven leadership in open-source projects and community contributions (e.g., GISCollective)
Experience with performance optimization in low-latency systems (e.g., at Dunnhumby)
concerns: No direct experience with SoC/IP modeling or hardware-software co-design required for the role
Lacks demonstrated expertise in AI accelerator architecture or deep-learning workload optimization
Educational background (BSc Computer Science) does not meet the preferred advanced degree or PhD requirement
